source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Small tree 3–6(–12) m, branchlets thorny or sometimes nearly thornless
morphology_documented.leaves: Variable sometimes asymmetrical, hair tufts in main vein axils on lower surface
morphology_documented.fruit: Round red to orange-red pomes 5–8 mm across

source_scope_note: Genus/key traits explicitly identified; modern secondary evidence separately cited; no unsupported species characters inferred.
